Intro: At ease. We've already investigated your restaurant. I'm sure you've heard of me.
Svetka Serebryakova, Army General and new Lady of Verehn. Someone had to take over after those pigs all died.
Now all that's left is for the nation to fall into line. Verehn especially.
The quarantine has had people moaning and groaning in the streets, as if they wanted the rest of the nation to be infected too.
If they're so dissatisfied, they've been shown the ne plus ultra of revolutions. Yet they can't even follow such a clear example.
The rebels are a disorganized mess, stepping on each other's toes while spouting florid messages about a utopia they could never create—
Choking, suffocating on useless words and dying to their own thoughtless actions.
Meanwhile the common man is too worried about their own lives to do anything productive about their misery.
While I wouldn't mind if you were the same, it would please me if you were more… adroit. The next time I see your face, I do hope you'll serve me.
